structure_policy_rationale: 酷狗音乐的原始图标本身就是高度抽象的几何符号（圆+K），完全符合主题中关于‘几何块面组合’的要求。参考 Bilibili 和 Douyin 的案例，对于此类清晰的符号化 Logo，应保留其拓扑结构，仅对填充颜色、描边风格和质感进行主题化迁移，无需重构主体。
preserve: 内部大写 'K' 字母形态
蓝白配色的基础对比关系
圆环包围 K 字的同心布局
K 字的基本笔画走势（左侧竖线，右侧上下分叉）
must_preserve: 圆环与 K 字的相对位置关系
K 字作为核心识别主体的地位
recompose_allowed: 将标准亮蓝色映射为主题高饱和靛蓝/深宝蓝
将白色 K 字映射为主题奶黄/米白或保留高亮白
圆环线条的手绘化抖动与粗细不均处理
K 字端点的圆润化或钝角化处理以适配涂鸦风格
restyle: 添加粗重、不规则的黑色手绘描边
应用蜡笔/马克笔的干性涂抹质感
去除所有渐变、高光、阴影和立体效果
边缘处理为毛糙、非标准化的几何形态
forbid: 禁止保留原始的平滑矢量边缘
禁止使用原始的标准亮蓝色 (#0055FF) 而不进行主题色映射
禁止添加任何立体高光、环境光遮蔽或投影
禁止改变 K 字的字形结构（如变成小写 k 或其他字体）
禁止使用绿色、紫色等主题色板之外的颜色
禁止保留写实纹理或金属/玻璃光泽
generation_brief: Retro hand-drawn doodle icon on pure black background. Subject: Capital letter 'K' inside a circular ring. Colors: High-saturation indigo blue for the ring, creamy yellow/off-white for the 'K'. Style: Thick, rough black marker outlines with jitter, flat crayon texture, no gradients or shadows. Centered composition, clumsy and cute aesthetic.
color_application: Map original brand blue to theme's high-saturation indigo/deep blue; map original white to theme's creamy yellow or off-white. Use solid flat fills only, strictly avoiding gradients.
stroke_application: Apply heavy, irregular black hand-drawn strokes to both the outer ring and the inner 'K'. Ensure edges are rough and uneven, simulating a thick marker or crayon on paper.
composition_application: Center the 'K-in-ring' symbol. Scale it to occupy 60-70% of the canvas. Maintain the concentric layout but allow for slight handmade asymmetry in the ring's closure.
identity_application: Preserve the topological structure of the 'K' (vertical line + two diagonal branches) and the enclosing ring. Do not replace with music notes or other symbols. The identity is carried by the geometric shape, restyled with theme textures.
fidelity_constraints: Must have thick, rough hand-drawn black outlines
Colors must be limited to theme palette (Indigo/Blue, Cream/Yellow, Red)
negative_constraints: No original brand bright blue without theme mapping
No complex details or text watermarks
No neon glow or lighting effects
